original_text: Artificial intelligence is changing many industries around the world. It is being used in healthcare to assist doctors, in education to provide personalized learning, and in transportation to improve navigation and safety. Businesses are also using artificial intelligence to analyze large amounts of data and automate repetitive tasks. Although AI provides many benefits, organizations must also consider issues such as privacy, security, bias, and responsible use of technology.

original_text: Machine learning is a branch of artificial intelligence that enables computers to learn patterns from data without being explicitly programmed for every task. Machine learning algorithms are used in applications such as recommendation systems, fraud detection, image recognition, speech recognition, and medical diagnosis. The performance of these systems depends on the quality and quantity of the training data.
